evals.prompt: Build the closet grid screen: apps/mobile/src/features/closet should call GET /v1/closet/items via the generated client and show empty, loading, and failure states per the journeys doc.
evals.expected_output: A screen under apps/mobile/src/features/closet/ (with a tests/ directory) reads items only through packages/contracts' generated client, renders every state named in planning/02-user-journeys-and-information-architecture.md for this journey, and constructs no adapters itself — the API client comes from useAppServices() / the composition root. No business rule (e.g. filtering by season) is decided client-side.
assertions: New screen code lives under apps/mobile/src/features/closet/, with tests in a tests/ directory next to it, never under apps/mobile/src/app/
The screen imports request/response types only from the generated client in packages/contracts, never a hand-written type
Empty, loading, and failure states are all implemented, not just the happy path
No adapter (API client, analytics sink) is constructed inside the screen — it is read from the composition root's context
The agent's report names `just test mobile` as the command it ran and pastes the real output

evals.prompt: Add a 'rotate the avatar' button to the outfit review screen (apps/mobile/src/features/outfit) that spins the 3D avatar preview.
evals.expected_output: The agent recognizes the rotate interaction touches the Filament boundary (apps/mobile/src/render/) and stops or hands off to native-3d-assets for the render-side control, implementing only the screen-level button/UI wiring itself if that stays outside the boundary.
assertions: The agent does not add a react-native-filament import or a new file under apps/mobile/src/render/ itself
The agent explicitly names native-3d-assets (or render-3d-engineer) as the owner of the rotate control's implementation
Any UI-layer code the agent does add (e.g. a button) lives outside apps/mobile/src/render/ and apps/mobile/src/features/avatar/

evals.prompt: The consent toggle on the profile screen isn't sending an analytics event when the user opts in — PostHog dashboards show zero opt-in events even though the toggle flips visually.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats this as a regression: reproduces the failure with a test in apps/mobile/src/features/profile/tests/, confirms the event exists in the analytics taxonomy schema (packages/contracts), fixes the wiring so the event fires through the Analytics port in src/lib/analytics, and reruns the test to show it passing — without weakening the consent-default-off stub.
assertions: The agent pastes the actual failing test output captured before the fix, not a paraphrase
The fix goes through the Analytics port in apps/mobile/src/lib/analytics, not a direct PostHog SDK call from the screen
The agent confirms the event name exists in the packages/contracts analytics taxonomy schema before wiring it
No real user data (measurements, photos) appears in the test fixture or the agent's report
The agent reruns `just test mobile` after the fix and reports the passing result
